column1: # Game profile of Hollow Knight: Silksong (Switch, update 1.0.30000 = v655360). Plays on the Mac and on the iPhone
# Format: see dm/games/README.md
# Unity 6000.0.50f1 (IL2CPP) with FMOD, SDK 20.5.8; subsdk0 is the movie module, which plays the 27 MP4 cinematics (H.264 and AAC; Intro_Cinematic.mp4 after a new file).
# Nearly everything is in 2,068 Addressables bundles (StreamingAssets/aa/Switch), whose Shader objects carry type trees (the bundles report engine version 0.0.0), so unityfs.py reads them
# without a written-out layout. The host needed nn::hid::GetDebugPadStates, which Unity 6 polls every frame (hle_hid.c).

# ---- Memory ----
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true. Unity 6's nninitStartup (main+0x118cb70) only queries the memory info and sets the TLS allocator:
# no heap and no StandardAllocator; Unity takes its memory itself through nn::os::AllocateAddressRegion and AllocateMemoryPages in the alias region. The 5 GB block of the other Unity games

# with virtual address memory (256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region), with the node area cut for this sdk build (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py). Measured on the
# Mac: the alias region's high-water mark +2.26 GB in the first room of play (+3.00 GB before the cut), 1.51 GB mapped, resident 2.1 GB and 1.25 GB of GPU memory, flat for 100 s of play.
# The pool is the hardware's (3.2 GB): Unity only reads it through QueryMemoryInfo, and nothing maps against it
sys_resource
mem_reserve
mem_alias
mem_stack
app_pool

# ---- Graphics ----
# Byte slots in the boot scene bundle the file layer serves by operation mode (hle_fs.c serve_patch; n: = narrow screens
# only, where the handheld frame centre-crops the stock canvas and the docked frame is stretched by the front end). The HUD
# rig baked into Menu_Title puts the silk-spool cluster at the stock frame's left edge: its Thread and Health group roots
# (x 0.0 / 8.19) are served shifted +100 canvas px in handheld mode and stock in docked mode. Thread's local scale Y (stock
# 1.0) is served 0.856603 in docked mode -- the reciprocal of the iPad mini's docked present stretch (1920x1080 onto
# 2266x1488) -- so the spool lands round; under Thread the two offsets (+1.19 at -1.17) cancel in the scale, so the Bind Orb
# and everything hung on it (the Hunter bars, the crest effects) keeps its stock place. Health's scale Y is NOT served: its
# mask anchors sit +7.70 above the group origin, every state variant of every mask among them, and the first build that
# scaled it (slim-90) pulled the whole mask row 1.1 units off its stock place in docked mode (device-checked). Bit
# patterns from the bundle of build fc9ea4cc
serve_patch
# The launcher's frame-rate choice (settings.tsv SS_DISPLAY_HZ): 60, 120 at the full render size, or 120 at a lowered render size
# (1916x882, the size the touch port measured on this class of screen). The front end drives the present, the present link and the
# vi vsync event at the rate it measures on the screen, and falls back to 60 when the screen cannot hold 120 (hle_nvn.c)
display_hz
